entries.title: Assertiveness basics
entries.summary: Tell assertive, passive and aggressive responses apart.

entries.title: Name your needs
entries.summary: Identify what matters to you before you ask for a change.

entries.title: Speak and be heard
entries.summary: Make a clear request and respond when someone interrupts you.

entries.title: Set boundaries
entries.summary: Say no to extra work and offer an alternative you can manage.

entries.title: Handle conflict
entries.summary: Use a time-out to cool down and agree on when to return to the conversation.

entries.title: Make an action plan
entries.summary: Choose three observable actions and decide when to practise them at work.

seeds.question: Can I practise with a partner?
seeds.author: instructor
seeds.answer: Yes. Take turns making a request and giving feedback on how clear it was.

seeds.question: How do you practise when you feel nervous?
seeds.author: learner
seeds.answer: I tried my first request with a colleague I trust. That made the next one easier.
